mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopwizard.tAdjAdjust WHERE AdjustStartDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pAdjustStartDate}, '%Y%m%d') AND AdjustStartDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pAdjustEndDate}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND AdjustEndDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pAdjustStartDate}, '%Y%m%d') AND AdjustEndDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pAdjustEndDate}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND AdjustNo = #{pAdjustNo}

SELECT A.AdjustNo, A.AdjustStartDate, A.AdjustEndDate, B.BranchId, B.BranchCode, B.BranchName, A.VatRate, SUM(D.SalePrice) AS SaleAmt, SUM(D.BuyPrice) AS BuyAmt, SUM(D.ProdMargin) AS ProdMargin, A.TaxinvImg, A.TaxinvMemo, A.State, A.Remark, A.RegistId, A.RegistName, A.RegistDate, A.ChangeId, A.ChangeName, A.ChangeDate FROM shopwizard.tAdjAdjust A INNER JOIN shopwizard.tAdjAdjustDetail D ON A.AdjustNo = D.SaleAdjustNo INNER JOIN shopion.tPrfBranch B ON A.BranchId = B.BranchId INNER JOIN shopion.tPrfComp C ON A.CompCode = C.CompCode WHERE A.AdjustStartDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pStartDate}, '%Y%m%d') AND A.AdjustEndDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pEndDate}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND A.CompCode = #{pCompCode} GROUP BY A.AdjustNo, B.BranchId, B.BranchCode, B.BranchName, D.VatRate

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopwizard.tAdjAdjust A INNER JOIN shopion.tPrfBranch B ON A.BranchId = B.BranchId INNER JOIN shopion.tPrfComp C ON A.CompCode = C.CompCode WHERE A.AdjustStartDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pStartDate}, '%Y%m%d') AND A.AdjustEndDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pEndDate}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND A.CompCode = #{pCompCode}

SELECT A.AdjustNo, A.AdjustStartDate, A.AdjustEndDate, S.ShopCode, S.ShopName, A.VatRate, SUM(D.SalePrice) AS SaleAmt, SUM(D.BuyPrice) AS BuyAmt, SUM(D.ProdMargin) AS ProdMargin, SUM(D.DeliFeeAmt) AS DeliFeeAmt, A.State, A.Remark, A.RegistId, A.RegistName, A.RegistDate, A.ChangeId, A.ChangeName, A.ChangeDate FROM shopwizard.tAdjAdjust A INNER JOIN shopwizard.tAdjAdjustDetail D ON A.AdjustNo = D.AdjustNo INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpShop S ON A.ShopCode = S.ShopCode WHERE A.AdjustStartDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pStartDate}, '%Y%m%d') AND A.AdjustEndDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pEndDate}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND A.ShopCode = #{pShopCode} AND S.adjustPeriodCode = #{pAdjustPeriodType} GROUP BY A.AdjustNo, S.ShopCode, S.ShopName, D.VatRate
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopwizard.tAdjAdjust (AdjustNo, SupplyCode, ShopCode, AdjustStartDate, AdjustEndDate, AdjustMonth, PayDate, ReciptBank, ReciptAccnt, ReciptDepost, ChnlCode, VatRate, AdjustPeriodCode, TaxinvCheckDate, TaxinvSect, TaxinvMemo, CompCode, BranchId, State, Remark, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate) VALUES (#{adjustNo}, #{supplyCode}, #{shopCode}, #{adjustStartDate}, #{adjustEndDate}, #{adjustMonth}, #{payDate}, #{reciptBank}, #{reciptAccnt}, #{reciptDepost}, #{chnlCode}, #{vatRate}, #{adjustPeriodCode}, #{taxinvCheckDate}, #{taxinvSect}, #{taxinvMemo}, #{compCode}, #{branchId}, #{state}, #{remark}, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE shopwizard.tAdjAdjust SET TaxinvCheckDate = NOW(), TaxinvSect = #{taxinvSect}, TaxinvMemo = #{taxinvMemo}, TaxinvImg = #{taxinvImg}, State = #{state}, Remark = #{remark}, ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE AdjustNo = #{adjustNo}
